default_root.description: Base directory for centralized worktrees (e.g. '~/worktrees'). Will be created with configured permissions if missing.

naming_strategy.description: 'hierarchical' places worktrees under {default_root}/{repo-name}/{leaf}. 'flat' places worktrees under {default_root}/{repo-name}-{leaf}.

permissions.description: Octal permissions string for the worktrees root directory (e.g. '0700').

root.description: Explicit custom root directory for this repository.

naming_strategy.description: Override naming strategy for this project.

legacy_fallback.description: Whether to also approve legacy in-repo .worktrees/ as an authorized fallback.
